children: U.S. business communications platform's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 4% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company raised full-year outlook for revenue, profitability, and cash flow from operations
Growth driven by increased adoption of AI solutions and platform enhancements
8x8 raises full-year 2027 outlook for revenue, profitability, and cash flow from operations
Company expects Q3 total revenue between $188 mln and $192 mln
8x8 forecasts fiscal 2027 total revenue of $750 mln to $770 mln
AI SOLUTIONS ADOPTION - Co said accelerating adoption of AI solutions, including AI Studio, contributed to revenue growth
PLATFORM ENHANCEMENTS - Co cited recent updates to its platform, such as Customer 360 and JourneyIQ, as supporting improved customer experience and operational efficiency
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the integrated telecommunications services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for 8x8 Inc is $3.00, about 43.9% above its November 3 closing price of $2.09
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
